articles.title: CLARITY Act odds fall to 16% as key Democrats resist GOP’s ‘final’ offer
articles.summary: Banking groups also said the GOP’s final text leaves stablecoin reward loopholes, while tribal gaming interests warn that its prediction market provisions threaten tribal sovereignty.

articles.title: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote
articles.summary: Eight banking groups on Monday said they want tighter limits on stablecoin rewards, keeping the ongoing banks-versus-crypto dispute alive in Congress.

articles.title: CLARITY Act vote meets Fed rate hike: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.summary: Bitcoin traders brace for volatility as the CLARITY Act awaits a Senate vote to move forward and the Fed is due to announce its latest rate decision.

articles.title: Kaiko extends Series B funding round to $110 million with S&P Global, BNP Paribas
articles.summary: Financial rating giant S&P Global joined top traditional banks and exchange operators to fund Kaiko's expansion into continuous market data services

articles.title: Fragmented regulations limit stablecoin adoption in international finance: WTO head
articles.summary: Stablecoins may reduce trade finance friction, fragmented regulatory regimes limit their adoption to just 3% of global payments, according to the World Trade Organization.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Strive adds 469 Bitcoin to reach 25,000 BTC treasury
articles.summary: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase was funded entirely through its SATA preferred stock as the company continues its rapid climb among corporate BTC holders.

articles.title: SEC Grants Exemptive Relief from Certain Inline XBRL Filing or Submission Requirements
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission issued an order granting exemptive relief from certain Inline XBRL requirements adopted on Dec. 16, 2024. More specifically, the Commission is granting exemptive relief from filing or submitting the following in…

articles.title: U.S. DOJ seeks $61 million in what it calls Iran's crypto-laundered black market oil sales
articles.summary: Prosecutors have filed a civil forfeiture complaint against what they call Iran's illegal crypto proceeds that are used to fund its military.

articles.title: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
articles.summary: Batch V1.1 would let users bundle up to eight linked transactions into one operation, with 27 of 35 trusted validators now backing the change.

articles.title: Balancer eyes wind-down after restructuring fails to revive revenue
articles.summary: Balancer cut costs and shipped new products after restructuring, but Marcus Hardt says v3 failed to replace legacy revenue as November’s $128 million exploit continued to weigh on adoption.

articles.title: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock
articles.summary: Crypto wallet providers must submit an early vulnerability report within 24 hours and a full notification within 72 hours of exploits, or risk administrative fines of as much as $17.3 million.

articles.title: Symbiosis says recovered 15 BTC from bridge hack, offers 20% bounty
articles.summary: Symbiosis is offering a 20% bounty for information leading to asset recovery after the hacker refused to return the stolen funds for the same white-hat bounty.

articles.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, narrowing the gap with Ethereum
articles.summary: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.

articles.title: Even if Clarity fails, Wall Street’s crypto push is unlikely to stop
articles.summary: The Clarity Act could give banks, brokers and asset managers a clearer rulebook, but financial firms have already moved far enough into digital assets that failure may slow adoption rather than stop it.

articles.title: Kraken brings DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
articles.summary: Kraken’s new xStocks vaults let investors earn yield on tokenized versions of Nvidia and major US stock market ETFs by lending the assets in DeFi markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $463M in weekly reversal as Ether ETFs gain $197M
articles.summary: ARKB, GBTC and IBIT led Bitcoin ETF withdrawals, while BlackRock’s ETHA pushed Ether ETFs into weekly inflows.

articles.title: SEC's Atkins backs Clarity Act but says agency will keep pushing crypto rules without it
articles.summary: The SEC chair said crypto issuance, transfer agent modernization and custody will form the backbone of the agency’s regulatory push.

articles.title: S&P Global backs Kaiko as Series B reaches $110M
articles.summary: The investment brings together major financial institutions as Kaiko expands its data infrastructure for tokenized securities and onchain financial markets.

articles.title: A bipartisan coalition of 17 state attorneys generals urge Senate to reject Clarity Act
articles.summary: The state AGs said they were concerned the crypto legislation might restrict their ability to bring securities and commodities cases tied to online scams.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slides from nearly $80,000 as Senate votes on Clarity Act
articles.summary: Senators take a procedural vote on the crypto market structure bill later Tuesday. Bitcoin has given back 3% since touching $79,530 overnight, with XRP and zcash the only majors gaining ground.

articles.title: Bitmine projects $334M in annual staking revenue from $15.8B crypto treasury
articles.summary: Bitmine now has more than 5 million ETH staked, turning most of its Ether holdings into a recurring income stream as it continues to accumulate.

articles.title: Consensus heads to Hong Kong for third year with expanded focus on AI
articles.summary: Consensus Hong Kong will focus on institutional adoption of digital assets and the growing role of artificial intelligence in the future of money.

articles.title: CoinEx to cease operation after 9 years, citing ‘significant’ crypto contraction
articles.summary: CoinEx said falling trading volumes and liquidity, along with rising regulatory and compliance costs, had exceeded “reasonable boundaries,” with withdrawals remaining open until Dec. 22.

articles.title: Democrats send counteroffer to Republicans over Clarity Act provisions
articles.summary: Democratic Senators were said to be meeting late Monday to discuss the latest proposed draft text.

articles.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
articles.summary: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips to $77,800 as Senate Clarity Act vote nears and oil prices climb
articles.summary: Bitcoin pulls back from $79,000 as the Senate prepares to vote on the Clarity Act and oil prices rise.

articles.title: Democrats push back on GOP’s ‘final’ CLARITY offer with counterproposal: Politico
articles.summary: Some Democrats remain dissatisfied with the bill’s crypto ethics provisions and will be sending a counterproposal just hours before a key procedural vote.

articles.title: U.S. Senator Lummis says Democrats won't quit asking for more on crypto Clarity Act
articles.summary: One of the top crypto market structure negotiators in Washington says she's run out of gas on new revisions for the bill she's worked on for more than five years.

articles.title: Robinhood plans share redemptions, voting rights for stock tokens, after criticism
articles.summary: CEO Vlad Tenev said more shareholder features are coming as Robinhood’s offshore stock tokens draw scrutiny over ownership rights.

articles.title: Trump's $800 million stake into World Liberty Financial's token now has a timeline to becoming sellable
articles.summary: Onchain records show that an $800 million crypto stake that matched Donald Trump's holding was moved into a vesting contract, locking any sales until 2028 after a mandatory 10% token burn.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $79K, oil falls as Trump says Iran war could end
articles.summary: Bitcoin’s price rose toward $80,000 after US President Donald Trump hinted that the US-Iran war would end, pushing oil prices lower.

articles.title: White House crypto adviser says Trump gave up 'historic' ethics powers in compromise
articles.summary: President Donald Trump's digital assets adviser spoke at a Washington event the day after a new compromise language was released for the Clarity Act.

articles.title: CLARITY Act faces state AGs opposition ahead of key Senate vote
articles.summary: Trump’s ethics concession addresses one hurdle for the crypto bill, but 18 state attorneys general say the revised legislation would weaken state oversight.

articles.title: Why are AI’s biggest companies suddenly asking to slow down?
articles.summary: AI’s biggest labs are suddenly calling for a slower pace of development. Is it because AI risks are catching up with the technology, or because the economics of the race are getting harder to justify?

articles.title: Clarity Act odds surge on prediction markets, but crypto bill still faces long road
articles.summary: Kalshi and Polymarket bettors sharply raised the chances of U.S. crypto market structure legislation advancing, with Tuesday's Senate vote the next test.

articles.title: Don’t let perfect be the enemy of Clarity
articles.summary: On September 15, the Senate has the chance to show that it can address issues in a reasonable timeframe, rather than waiting for the next market failure to act, writes the Blockchain Association's Summer Mersinger.

articles.title: Here is the revised Clarity Act ethics provision Donald Trump has agreed to
articles.summary: The new Clarity Act draft would force divestiture and give state attorneys general the ability to sue to enforce the ethics provision.

articles.title: HYPE price could suffer as Binance takes its revenue: Alice Liu
articles.summary: Token buybacks have pushed Hyperliquid to all time highs, but Alice Liu from CoinMarketCap warns that Binance poses a threat to the revenue stream it depends on to pay for them.

articles.title: UK FCA seeks views on fund rule exemptions for tokenized gold
articles.summary: The FCA said uncertainty over whether some tokenized gold products fall under UK fund rules could affect adoption and investor access.

articles.title: King Charles to host AI chiefs amid industry call to slow development
articles.summary: The gathering comes days after Dario Amodei and Sam Altman called for greater restraint at the AI frontier, warning that rapidly improving systems could pose increasingly difficult-to-control risks.

creator_7_3.causal_claim_policy: Observational evidence is a hypothesis. Matched within-asset agreement reduces confounding but does not prove causality. Fresh controlled replication is required before stable promotion.

current_experiment.reason: Choose the next test where additional evidence can reduce uncertainty without sacrificing editorial quality.
stop_rules: Do not claim causality from observational evidence.
Skip weak stories rather than manufacture a test post.
Never use fake engagement or guaranteed-return language.

creator_7_5.next_action: Prefer a DISCOVERY opportunity that passes all existing gates. If unavailable, choose the strongest qualified opportunity rather than manufacturing a portfolio slot.
rules: Diversify across discovery, market intelligence, accountability, education, debate, macro and selective memes.

next_actions: Feed repeated attributable signals into Creator 7.4 experiment selection as hypotheses, not guarantees.

experiment.use_policy: apply only when naturally supported by the selected story

next_cycle.instruction: Continue research/diversification. Waiting is correct when evidence or story quality is insufficient.

creator_pattern_hypotheses.hypothesis: Timely, useful content is more likely to earn attention than generic recaps.

A concrete binary or multi-choice question lowers the effort required to reply.
Rotating formats reduces audience fatigue and creates more experiments.

editorial_principles.audience_value: Prefer stories that teach something, explain why a move matters, reveal an unusual development or create a substantive debate.
editorial_principles.breaking_news_override: A genuinely major verified breaking event may override topic cooldowns, but ordinary price movement may not.
editorial_principles.comment_quality: Prefer one specific evidence-based question with multiple defensible viewpoints over generic engagement bait.
editorial_principles.diversification: Compare opportunities across BTC, ETH, BNB, major altcoins, macro, regulation, liquidations, institutional activity and breaking news.
editorial_principles.evidence: Separate verified facts, observed market data, inference and unknowns. Never invent a causal explanation or statistic.
editorial_principles.human_editor_test: Before selecting a topic, ask whether an experienced crypto editor would spend one of the account's limited publishing opportunities on this story right now.
editorial_principles.learning: Treat individual post performance as noisy. Do not declare a winning topic from one post; use repeated observations before changing strategy.
editorial_principles.novelty: Do not repeat the same asset, event or angle merely because its raw market score remains high.
editorial_principles.publish_standard: Publish only when a story is genuinely useful, timely, evidence-backed and differentiated. Skipping is better than filler.
editorial_principles.visual_quality: Use a visual only when it adds truthful information. Market charts must use real supplied market data.

growth_portfolio.instruction: Prefer a DISCOVERY opportunity that passes all existing gates. If unavailable, choose the strongest qualified opportunity rather than manufacturing a portfolio slot.

I’m watching $MTL for the reaction, not chasing the headline move.

Price is around $0.3, with $2.1M in quote volume and a 29.3% intraday range. On the recent 1H window, the observed range runs from about $0.296 to $0.381.

The current classification is technical setup. That is a description of the setup, not a promise about the next candle.

I would rather wait for price to confirm the reaction than manufacture certainty from one move.

📊 MTL 1H: price $0.3 • support $0.296 • resistance $0.381 • TP1 $0.27475 • target $0.2535 • SL / invalidation $0.381 (short bias).

Levels are chart-derived scenarios, not guarantees.

For $MTL, that matters because the existing 29.3% move is the market fact behind the reaction, while the next response shows whether traders are accepting or rejecting it.

What specific reaction on $MTL would make you change your read?
